"""Exact ownership of generated city visibility pieces inside one native tag."""
import re
import math
from pathlib import Path
from atelier.conventions import to_unreal
from atelier.model_files import regular_files
from atelier.atomic_files import atomic_json
import json

SOURCES = ('HD_Terrain', 'HD_Streets', 'HD_Square')
CELL = r'(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)'
DESTINATION = '/Game/Experiments/CitySurfaces/v1_128m'
TRIANGLE_LIMIT = 32768


def require_sources(sources):
    if not isinstance(sources, dict) or set(sources) != set(SOURCES):
        raise ValueError('City tile import requires all three production surfaces')


def native_bounds(tile):
    """Blender world metres -> Unreal centimetres, including handedness."""
    low, high = tile['min'], tile['max']
    if (len(low) != 3 or len(high) != 3 or any(type(v) not in (float, int) or not math.isfinite(v) for v in (*low, *high))
            or any(a > b for a, b in zip(low, high))):
        raise ValueError('Invalid city piece bounds')
    a, b = to_unreal(low), to_unreal(high)
    return ((a[0], b[1], a[2]), (b[0], a[1], b[2]))


def production_groups(manifest):
    """@cc [owner:fontanierh,label:correctness;performance] city-pieces-replace-native-parents
    Production pieces MUST cover every declared parent triangle exactly once and
    retain its placement frame and source material table. Authored collision hulls
    MUST have exactly one piece owner; every piece retains its own complex surface.
    Missing, partial or unbounded membership MUST refuse before loading a parent or
    publishing replacement data. This table MUST contain no parent mesh reference.
    """
    if (not isinstance(manifest, dict) or manifest.get('version') != 2
            or manifest.get('complete') is not True or manifest.get('tag') != 'v1_128m'
            or manifest.get('triangle_limit') != TRIANGLE_LIMIT):
        raise ValueError('Missing complete production city pieces')
    sources = manifest.get('sources')
    require_sources(sources)
    groups, seen = {}, set()
    for source, row in sources.items():
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            raise ValueError('Invalid production city source record')
        count = row.get('source_triangles')
        hulls = row.get('source_collision_hulls')
        vertices = row.get('source_collision_vertices')
        slots = row.get('source_material_slots')
        if (type(count) is not int or count < 1 or type(hulls) is not int or hulls < 0
                or not isinstance(slots, list) or not slots
                or any(not isinstance(slot, str) or not slot for slot in slots)
                or len(set(slots)) != len(slots)
                or not isinstance(vertices, list) or len(vertices) != hulls
                or any(not isinstance(hull, list) or len(hull) < 4
                       or any(not isinstance(vertex, list) or len(vertex) != 3
                              or any(type(v) not in (float, int) or not math.isfinite(v) for v in vertex)
                              for vertex in hull) for hull in vertices)
                or not isinstance(row.get('tiles'), list) or not row['tiles']):
            raise ValueError('Invalid production city source metadata')
        native_bounds(row['source_bounds'])
        material_paths(slots)
        pieces = []
        for tile in row['tiles']:
            if not isinstance(tile, dict):
                raise ValueError('Invalid city piece record')
            name, triangles, collision = tile.get('name'), tile.get('triangles'), tile.get('collision_hulls')
            if (not tile_name(source, name) or name in seen or type(triangles) is not int
                    or not 1 <= triangles <= TRIANGLE_LIMIT or type(collision) is not int
                    or collision not in (0, hulls)):
                raise ValueError('Invalid bounded production city piece')
            native_bounds(tile)
            seen.add(name)
            pieces.append(dict(asset=DESTINATION+'/'+name+'.'+name, triangles=triangles,
                               collision_hulls=collision))
        if (sum(piece['triangles'] for piece in pieces) != count
                or sum(piece['collision_hulls'] for piece in pieces) != hulls
                or sum(piece['collision_hulls'] > 0 for piece in pieces) != int(hulls > 0)):
            raise ValueError('Incomplete city geometry or collision ownership')
        groups[source] = pieces
    return groups


def material_paths(slots):
    """The same authored HDS slots bind the city's existing owned materials."""
    result = {}
    for name in slots:
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'HDS_[a-z][a-z0-9_]*', name):
            raise ValueError('Unsupported production city material slot')
        slug = name.removeprefix('HDS_')
        result[name] = ('/Game/Japan/Materials/MI_Road' if slug == 'road' else
                        '/Game/Japan/Hidamari/Materials/MI_HD_'+slug)
    return result


def collision_matches(mesh, row, tile, *, read_vertices=None):
    """Read actual imported UCX vertices, including each native shape transform.

    FBX metre/axis conversion may round coordinates to float32; the comparison
    permits two float32 ulps, with a 0.001 cm floor. No hull/vertex may disappear.
    """
    # FKConvexElem.Transform is protected in reflected Python. Native code uses
    # its public getter and rejects nonconvex/nonfinite shapes before readback.
    if read_vertices is None:
        import unreal
        read_vertices = unreal.CitySurfaceValidation.collision_vertices
    try:
        hulls = json.loads(read_vertices(mesh))
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return False
    if (not isinstance(hulls, list)
            or any(not isinstance(hull, list) or len(hull)<4
                   or any(not isinstance(point, list) or len(point)!=3
                          or any(type(v) not in (float, int) or not math.isfinite(v) for v in point)
                          for point in hull) for hull in hulls)):
        return False
    expected = row['source_collision_vertices'] if tile['collision_hulls'] else []
    if len(hulls) != len(expected):
        return False
    actual = [sorted(hull) for hull in hulls]
    # Import may reorder hulls and vertices. Convex geometry is identified by
    # its complete vertex set, rather than just its count or bounding box.
    remaining = list(actual)
    for points in expected:
        match = next((i for i, candidate in enumerate(remaining)
                      if len(points) == len(candidate) and all(
                          abs(a-b) <= max(.001, 2.**(math.frexp(max(abs(a), abs(b)))[1]-23))
                          for left, right in zip(sorted(points), candidate) for a, b in zip(left, right))), None)
        if match is None:
            return False
        remaining.pop(match)
    return not remaining


def protected_files(root):
    """A local mutation guard, not a byte certificate or cross-run reuse proof.

    The piece importer never owns writes beneath this sibling root. Observe all
    regular file identities without rereading gigabytes of unrelated assets.
    """
    root = Path(root).absolute()
    if any(path.is_symlink() for path in (root, *root.parents)):
        raise ValueError('Linked protected city content')
    result = {}
    for name in regular_files(root):
        info = (root / name).stat()
        result[name] = (info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_mode, info.st_size, info.st_mtime_ns, info.st_ctime_ns)
    return result


def tile_name(source, name):
    return isinstance(name, str) and re.fullmatch(re.escape(source) + '_cell_' + CELL + '_' + CELL + r'(?:_Piece[0-3]{1,16})?', name) is not None


def owned_tiles(asset_paths, destination):
    """Enumerate only generated tile names inside the owner's exact tag root."""
    report = {source: [] for source in SOURCES}
    for asset in asset_paths:
        if not isinstance(asset, str) or not asset.startswith(destination + '/'):
            continue
        name = asset[len(destination) + 1:].split('.')[0]
        for source, tiles in report.items():
            if tile_name(source, name):
                if asset != destination + '/' + name + '.' + name:
                    raise ValueError('Invalid generated city tile object path')
                tiles.append({'name': name, 'asset': asset})
                break
    return report


def obsolete_assets(previous, current, destination):
    """@cc [owner:fontanierh,label:correctness] retire-only-superseded-city-pieces
    Only previously inventoried owned tiles inside this exact destination MAY
    retire, after every current tile has imported and validated. Source packages,
    other tags and current pieces MUST never enter the deletion list. Invalid
    ownership evidence MUST refuse rather than widen the deletion scope.
    """
    if not isinstance(destination, str) or not re.fullmatch('/Game/Experiments/CitySurfaces/[A-Za-z0-9_]+', destination):
        raise ValueError('Invalid city tile destination')

    def inventory(report):
        if not isinstance(report, dict):
            raise ValueError('Invalid city tile ownership report')
        found = set()
        for source, tiles in report.items():
            if source not in SOURCES or not isinstance(tiles, list):
                raise ValueError('Invalid city tile source membership')
            for tile in tiles:
                if not isinstance(tile, dict):
                    raise ValueError('Invalid city tile record')
                name = tile.get('name')
                if not tile_name(source, name):
                    raise ValueError('Invalid city tile package name')
                asset = destination + '/' + name + '.' + name
                if tile.get('asset') != asset or asset in found:
                    raise ValueError('Invalid or duplicate city tile package ownership')
                found.add(asset)
        return found

    return sorted(inventory(previous) - inventory(current))


def assemble(root, log=print):
    """Assemble completed independent city sources without regenerating siblings."""
    root = Path(root)
    sources = {}
    for source in SOURCES:
        report = json.loads((root / source / 'manifest.json').read_text())
        if (report.get('version') != 2 or report.get('complete') is not True
                or report.get('tag') != 'v1_128m' or report.get('cell_metres') != 128
                or report.get('triangle_limit') != TRIANGLE_LIMIT
                or set(report.get('sources', {})) != {source}):
            raise ValueError('Incomplete independent city source: '+source)
        sources[source] = report['sources'][source]
    result = dict(version=2, complete=True, tag='v1_128m', cell_metres=128,
                  triangle_limit=TRIANGLE_LIMIT, sources=sources)
    production_groups(result)
    # Source subfolders own current products. Retire only the former flat FBX
    # membership after all replacements exist; never remove a sibling owner.
    if any(path.is_symlink() for path in (root.absolute(), *root.absolute().parents)):
        raise ValueError('Linked city assembly root')
    actual = regular_files(root)
    expected = {source+'/'+tile['name']+'.fbx'
                for source,row in sources.items() for tile in row['tiles']}
    if not expected <= actual:
        raise ValueError('Missing completed city source member')
    legacy = [name for name in actual if '/' not in name and name.endswith('.fbx')
              and any(tile_name(source, name[:-4]) for source in SOURCES)]
    atomic_json(root / 'manifest.json', result)
    for name in legacy:
        (root / name).unlink()
    log('CITY PIECES assembled '+str(sum(len(row['tiles']) for row in sources.values())))


def parents_retired(content):
    """A receiving absence postcondition, independent of copied piece products."""
    root = Path(content) / 'Japan/Assets'
    if any(path.is_symlink() for path in (root.absolute(), *root.absolute().parents)):
        return False
    # Every regular sidecar is covered by the exact primary stem; never scan
    # or claim ownership of another world's package directory.
    return all(not path.exists() and not path.is_symlink()
               for name in SOURCES for path in root.glob(name+'.*'))

"""Exact membership-only compatibility proof for the city parent handoff.

This does not certify geometry or packages. The native adapter must separately
reproduce the original receipt policy, source bytes, sidecars and current checks.
"""
import ast

PARENTS = ('HD_Terrain', 'HD_Streets', 'HD_Square')
IMPORTER = 'games/yorimichi/unreal/Scripts/import_hidamari.py'
CATALOG = 'games/yorimichi/world/asset_catalog.py'
SETUP = 'games/yorimichi/unreal/Scripts/setup_project.py'


def _remove_current_branch(tree, path):
    """Remove exactly one known delegation statement, with its exact location."""
    if path == IMPORTER:
        blocks = [node.body for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.For)
                  and ast.dump(node.target) == ast.dump(ast.parse('for name, entry in manifest.items(): pass').body[0].target)
                  and ast.dump(node.iter) == ast.dump(ast.parse('manifest.items()', mode='eval').body)]
        expected = ast.parse("if name in ('HD_Terrain', 'HD_Streets', 'HD_Square'):\n    continue").body[0]
        # It must follow the original selection filter, before source import.
        index = 1
    elif path == CATALOG:
        blocks = [node.body for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
                  and node.name == 'independently_owned']
        expected = ast.parse("if package in {'/Game/Japan/Assets/'+name for name in "
                             "('HD_Terrain', 'HD_Streets', 'HD_Square')}:\n    return True").body[0]
        index = 1  # the original function docstring still occupies the first slot
    else:
        return False
    if len(blocks) != 1 or len(blocks[0]) <= index or ast.dump(blocks[0][index]) != ast.dump(expected):
        return False
    del blocks[0][index]
    return True


def _remove_previous_purge(tree):
    """Normalize only the removed upfront namespace deletion, never imports."""
    owners = [node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == 'main']
    expected = ast.dump(ast.parse('purge()').body[0])
    if len(owners) != 1:
        return False
    indices = [i for i, node in enumerate(owners[0].body) if ast.dump(node) == expected]
    source_load = ast.parse("W = json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT, 'world.json')))").body[0]
    if indices != [4] or ast.dump(owners[0].body[3]) != ast.dump(source_load):
        return False
    del owners[0].body[4]
    return True


def excluded_packages(previous, current):
    """@cc [owner:fontanierh,label:correctness] exact-city-delegation-owner-transition
    Original source texts MUST come from the invocation-bound producing inputs.
    Recovered member projections MUST have identical keys. An exact ORIGINAL
    local receipt header MUST independently prove full historical closure membership;
    receiptless bootstrap and donor transitions MUST remain disabled. Only
    the exact three-parent skip/delegation statements and removal of the upfront
    main() purge call MAY differ; imports and finishing MUST remain identical; every remaining AST MUST agree. These three generated
    parent packages MUST be excluded from historical admission. No other source,
    owner finishing, native validator or byte evidence MAY be relaxed. Unsupported
    history MUST refuse and use the ordinary import path.
    """
    if (not isinstance(previous, dict) or not isinstance(current, dict)
            or not previous or set(previous) != set(current)):
        return None
    changed = False
    try:
        for path in previous:
            old = ast.parse(previous[path])
            new = ast.parse(current[path])
            if ast.dump(old) == ast.dump(new):
                continue
            if path == SETUP:
                if not _remove_previous_purge(old):
                    return None
            elif path not in (IMPORTER, CATALOG) or not _remove_current_branch(new, path):
                return None
            if ast.dump(old) != ast.dump(new):
                return None
            changed = True
    except (ValueError, TypeError, SyntaxError):
        return None
    return tuple('/Game/Japan/Assets/'+name for name in PARENTS) if changed else None
sources.games/yorimichi/unreal/Scripts/import_ci:
"""Import a completed, isolated partition; never reimport production geometry/materials.

Set CITY_SURFACE_TILES_TAG to the tag produced by city_surface_tiles.py.
Use a guarded commandlet with -noshaderworker. No level is saved.
"""
import sys as _sys; from pathlib import Path as _Path; _sys.path.insert(0, str(_Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'world')); import yori  # noqa: E402  (build/yorimichi = yori.OUT)
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import unreal

ROOT = yori.OUT
sys.path.insert(0, str(yori.GAME))
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from import_village import import_mesh
from atelier import native_membership
from city_tile_products import (obsolete_assets, owned_tiles, production_groups, native_bounds,
                                material_paths, collision_matches, protected_files)


def main():
    tag = os.environ['CITY_SURFACE_TILES_TAG']
    assert tag == 'v1_128m', 'Production city pieces require their canonical owner tag'
    folder = ROOT / 'city_surface_tiles' / tag
    manifest = json.loads((folder / 'manifest.json').read_text())
    groups = production_groups(manifest)
    production = yori.GAME / 'unreal/Content/Japan'
    before = protected_files(production)
    destination = '/Game/Experiments/CitySurfaces/' + tag
    # The source exporter replaces its folder; enumerate the native owner's
    # independent output root before importing, without relying on that report.
    previous = owned_tiles(unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.list_assets(destination, recursive=False,
                                                                 include_folder=False), destination)
    unreal.SystemLibrary.execute_console_command(None, 'Interchange.FeatureFlags.Import.FBX 0')
    unreal.SystemLibrary.execute_console_command(None, 'Editor.AsyncStaticMeshCompilation 0')
    unreal.load_module('StaticMeshEditor')
    report = {}
    for name, source in manifest['sources'].items():
        assert source['tiles'], ('Missing city surface pieces', name)
        # Material assets have their own world owner. Opening a whole render
        # parent just to discover these bindings defeats bounded preparation.
        slots = {slot: unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.load_asset(path)
                 for slot, path in material_paths(source['source_material_slots']).items()}
        assert slots and all(slots.values()), (name, 'production materials')
        material = next(iter(slots.values()))
        imported = []
        lower, upper = [float('inf')]*3, [-float('inf')]*3
        for index, tile in enumerate(source['tiles'], 1):
            path = folder / name / (tile['name'] + '.fbx')
            assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == tile['sha256']
            mesh = import_mesh(path, destination, tile['name'], fresh_slots=True)   # the slots of this partition, not a previous one's
            for i, s in enumerate(mesh.static_materials):
                key = str(s.get_editor_property('imported_material_slot_name'))
                assert key in slots, (tile['name'], 'unknown slot', key)
                if mesh.get_material(i) != slots[key]:
                    mesh.set_material(i, slots[key])
            assert mesh.get_num_triangles(0) == tile['triangles'], (tile['name'], 'triangle count changed')
            box = mesh.get_bounding_box()
            expected_min, expected_max = native_bounds(tile)
            for i, axis in enumerate(('x','y','z')):
                assert abs(getattr(box.min, axis) - expected_min[i]) < .2, (tile['name'], 'piece minimum bounds', axis)
                assert abs(getattr(box.max, axis) - expected_max[i]) < .2, (tile['name'], 'piece maximum bounds', axis)
                lower[i] = min(lower[i], getattr(box.min, axis))
                upper[i] = max(upper[i], getattr(box.max, axis))
            editor = unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.StaticMeshEditorSubsystem)
            settings = editor.get_lod_build_settings(mesh, 0)
            if not settings.get_editor_property('use_full_precision_u_vs'):
                settings.set_editor_property('use_full_precision_u_vs', True)
                editor.set_lod_build_settings(mesh, 0, settings)
            body = mesh.get_editor_property('body_setup')
            collision = (unreal.CollisionTraceFlag.CTF_USE_SIMPLE_AND_COMPLEX if source['source_collision_hulls']
                         else unreal.CollisionTraceFlag.CTF_USE_COMPLEX_AS_SIMPLE)
            if body.get_editor_property('collision_trace_flag') != collision:
                body.set_editor_property('collision_trace_flag', collision)
            assert collision_matches(mesh, source, tile), (tile['name'], 'authored UCX geometry')
            assert unreal.CitySurfaceValidation.validate_collision(mesh, tile['triangles'],
                bool(source['source_collision_hulls'])), (tile['name'], 'current cooked query surface')
            assert mesh.get_num_triangles(0) == tile['triangles'], (tile['name'], 'final render count')
            assert unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_loaded_asset(mesh, True), ('City tile save failed', tile['name'])
            imported.append(dict(name=tile['name'], triangles=mesh.get_num_triangles(0),
                                 material=material.get_path_name(), asset=mesh.get_path_name()))
            # The owner retains paths and counts, not all loaded piece geometry.
            # Collect in bounded batches, never once per unchanged mesh.
            mesh = body = None
            if index % 16 == 0:
                unreal.SystemLibrary.collect_garbage()
            unreal.log('CITY PIECES '+name+' '+str(index)+'/'+str(len(source['tiles'])))
        assert sum(t['triangles'] for t in imported) == source['source_triangles'], name
        expected_min, expected_max = native_bounds(source['source_bounds'])
        for i, axis in enumerate(('x','y','z')):
            assert abs(lower[i]-expected_min[i]) < .2, (name, 'minimum bounds', axis)
            assert abs(upper[i]-expected_max[i]) < .2, (name, 'maximum bounds', axis)
        report[name] = imported
    after = protected_files(production)
    assert after == before, 'Production Content/Japan changed during isolated import'
    # Current membership is complete before the previous owner's exact packages
    # retire. Unknown names and other tags never enter the deletion list.
    obsolete = obsolete_assets(previous, report, destination)
    # One preflight covers both former pieces and parents before any deletion.
    # Current/foreign package references must refuse the complete retirement.
    parents = {'/Game/Japan/Assets/'+name:[piece['asset'].split('.')[0] for piece in pieces]
               for name, pieces in groups.items()}
    current = [tile['asset'].split('.')[0] for tiles in report.values() for tile in tiles]
    replacements = {**parents, **{asset.split('.')[0]: current for asset in obsolete}}
    retired = native_membership.retire_replaced(unreal.EditorAssetLibrary, replacements)
    unreal.log('CITY PIECES retired packages=' + str(len(retired)))
    (folder / 'import-report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    unreal.log('CITY SURFACE TILE IMPORT COMPLETE ' + tag)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Import only the eastern city plus refreshed terrain backdrop, preserving gameplay assets."""
import sys as _sys; from pathlib import Path as _Path; _sys.path.insert(0, str(_Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'world')); import yori  # noqa: E402  (build/yorimichi = yori.OUT)
import json,sys,os
from pathlib import Path
import unreal
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from import_village import import_mesh,material
from mesh_materials import assign_materials
from harbor_material import material as harbor_material
from arcade_material import material as arcade_material
from plaza_material import water_material,paving_material
import city_material
ROOT = yori.OUT;OUT=ROOT/'hidamari'
unreal.SystemLibrary.execute_console_command(None,'Interchange.FeatureFlags.Import.FBX 0')
manifest=json.loads((OUT/'manifest.json').read_text());asked=set(filter(None,os.environ.get('HIDAMARI_ASSETS','').split(',')))
# A name ending in * asks for every manifest asset it begins: unreal.north imports HD_North* (the volcano, its
# materials and textures). The world import (setup_project.py) runs this with NORTH=False and leaves those out.
only={a for a in asked if not a.endswith('*')}|{n for n in manifest for a in asked if a.endswith('*') and n.startswith(a[:-1])}
assert only or not asked,('no Hidamari assets match',sorted(asked))
north=globals().get('NORTH',True)
# Hidamari owns the final harbour package. Every world reimport uses the same audited rail opening.
harbor_source=None
if 'HD_Harbor' in manifest and (not only or 'HD_Harbor' in only):
    from regions.hidamari.ferry_source import validated_harbor
    harbor_source=validated_harbor(yori.OUT,yori.REPO)
mat=unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.load_asset('/Game/Japan/Materials/M_Village') or material()
arcade_mat=arcade_material() if not only or any(n.startswith(('HD_Arcade','HD_Plaza','HD_Shop_')) or n in ['HD_ClockHall','HD_Square','HD_Station','HD_Shrine','HD_Park','HD_Streets','HD_CivicGardens'] for n in only) else None
paving_mat=arcade_material(paving=True) if not only or only & {'HD_ArcadeFloor','HD_PlazaFloor'} else None
plaza_paving=paving_material() if not only or 'HD_PlazaFloor' in only else None
plaza_water=water_material() if not only or 'HD_PlazaWater' in only else None
pond_water=water_material('M_PondWater') if not only or 'HD_InlandWater' in only else None
harbor_mat=harbor_material() if not only or only & {'HD_Harbor','HD_Boat'} else None
water_mat=harbor_material(water=True) if not only or 'HD_Sea' in only else None
report=json.loads((OUT/'import-report.json').read_text()) if only and (OUT/'import-report.json').exists() else {}
# The textured city (world/regions/hidamari/surfaces.py): a manifest entry with slots has one per surface.
city_mis=city_material.materials() if any('slots' in e for n,e in manifest.items() if not only or n in only) else {}
if any('road' in e.get('slots',{}) for n,e in manifest.items() if not only or n in only):
    # The arrival road runs on from the island road in the island road's own material (shared_materials.py).
    city_mis['road']=unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.load_asset('/Game/Japan/Materials/MI_Road')
    assert city_mis['road'],'MI_Road (setup_project) must exist before the arrival road is imported'
mountain_mat=gate_mat=rock_mat=None
if north:
    from mountain_material import material as mountain_material,gate_material,rock_material
    mountain_mat=mountain_material() if not only or any(n.startswith('HD_North') for n in only) else None
    rock_mat=rock_material(mountain_mat) if mountain_mat else None
    gate_mat=gate_material() if not only or 'HD_NorthGate' in only else None
def distance_lods(mesh,name,levels):
    """Reduce render geometry only; retain authored UCX and LOD0 complex collision."""
    unreal.load_module('StaticMeshEditor')
    subsystem=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.StaticMeshEditorSubsystem)
    assert subsystem is not None,'StaticMeshEditor subsystem is unavailable'
    original_collision=(subsystem.get_simple_collision_count(mesh),subsystem.get_convex_collision_count(mesh))
    original_triangles=mesh.get_num_triangles(0)
    options=unreal.StaticMeshReductionOptions()
    options.set_editor_property('auto_compute_lod_screen_size',False)
    settings=[]
    for fraction,size in levels:
        level=unreal.StaticMeshReductionSettings()
        level.set_editor_property('percent_triangles',fraction)
        level.set_editor_property('screen_size',size)
        settings.append(level)
    options.set_editor_property('reduction_settings',settings)
    count=len(levels)
    assert subsystem.set_lods(mesh,options)==count,(name,'LOD generation')
    assert subsystem.get_lod_count(mesh)==count,(name,'missing LOD')
    screen_sizes=[size for _,size in levels]
    assert subsystem.set_lod_screen_sizes(mesh,screen_sizes),(name,'LOD screen sizes')
    mesh.set_editor_property('lod_for_collision',0)
    collision=(subsystem.get_simple_collision_count(mesh),subsystem.get_convex_collision_count(mesh))
    result={'count':subsystem.get_lod_count(mesh),
            'vertices':[subsystem.get_number_verts(mesh,i) for i in range(count)],
            'triangles':[mesh.get_num_triangles(i) for i in range(count)],
            'screen_sizes':list(subsystem.get_lod_screen_sizes(mesh)),
            'collision_lod':mesh.get_editor_property('lod_for_collision'),
            'simple_collision_count':collision[0],'convex_collision_count':collision[1]}
    assert all(n>0 for n in result['vertices']),(name,'empty LOD')
    # Small meshes bottom out (a 140-triangle pine keeps 180 vertices at LOD1 and LOD2): never grow, and end smaller.
    assert all(a>=b for a,b in zip(result['vertices'],result['vertices'][1:])) and result['vertices'][-1]<result['vertices'][0],(name,'LOD reduction failed',result)
    assert result['triangles'][0]==original_triangles,(name,'LOD0 changed')
    assert len(result['screen_sizes'])==count
    assert all(abs(a-b)<1e-5 for a,b in zip(result['screen_sizes'],screen_sizes)),(name,'incorrect LOD screen sizes',result)
    assert collision==original_collision,(name,'authored collision changed',original_collision,collision)
    assert result['collision_lod']==0,(name,'complex collision must use original geometry')
    unreal.log('DISTANCE LODS '+name+' '+str(result))
    return result


def prop_lods(mesh,name,mi,levels):
    """A fitted prop's authored distance LODs (props.json `lods`: [triangles, screen size] per LOD, world/regions/hidamari
    /props.py): <name>_LOD<n>.fbx imported under /Game/Japan/Hidamari/PropLODs/<name> with the prop's material, set as
    LOD n of the mesh, at its screen size. LOD0 and the mesh's (absent) collision stay as imported."""
    unreal.load_module('StaticMeshEditor')
    subsystem=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.StaticMeshEditorSubsystem)
    assert subsystem is not None,'StaticMeshEditor subsystem is unavailable'
    if subsystem.get_lod_count(mesh)>1:mesh.set_num_source_models(1)   # a reimport keeps no stale LOD
    original=mesh.get_num_triangles(0)
    folder='/Game/Japan/Hidamari/PropLODs/'+name
    for level in range(1,len(levels)):
        source=import_mesh(OUT/'props'/f'{name}_LOD{level}.fbx',folder,f'{name}_LOD{level}',fresh_slots=True)
        assert len(source.static_materials)==1,(name,level,'material slots',len(source.static_materials))
        source.set_material(0,mi)
        assert unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.save_loaded_asset(source,False),(name,level,'save LOD source')
        assert subsystem.set_lod_from_static_mesh(mesh,level,source,0,True)==level,(name,level,'LOD')
    sizes=[float(size) for _,size in levels]
    assert subsystem.set_lod_screen_sizes(mesh,sizes),(name,'LOD screen sizes')
    result={'count':subsystem.get_lod_count(mesh),'triangles':[mesh.get_num_triangles(i) for i in range(len(levels))],
            'screen_sizes':list(subsystem.get_lod_screen_sizes(mesh))}
    assert result['count']==len(levels),(name,'missing LOD',result)
    assert result['triangles'][0]==original,(name,'LOD0 changed',result)
    # Unreal drops degenerate faces: within 2% of what Blender wrote, and each LOD lighter than the one before.
    assert all(abs(a-b)<=max(2,.02*b) for a,b in zip(result['triangles'],[t for t,_ in levels])),(name,'LOD triangles',result,levels)
    assert all(a>b for a,b in zip(result['triangles'],result['triangles'][1:])),(name,'LOD reduction',result)
    assert all(abs(a-b)<1e-5 for a,b in zip(result['screen_sizes'],sizes)),(name,'LOD screen sizes',result)
    unreal.log('PROP LODS '+name+' '+str(result))
    return result

"""Hidamari's final harbour source: the audited rail opening, with its source identity checked before import."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _verify(base, records):
    if not records:
        raise ValueError('Hidamari ferry access proof is missing source identities')
    for relative, wanted in records.items():
        path = base / relative
        if not path.is_file() or sha(path) != wanted:
            raise ValueError(f'Hidamari ferry access source changed: {relative}')


def validated_harbor(build, repo):
    """@cc [owner:fontanierh,label:correctness] hidamari-ferry-package-source
    Refuse missing/failed cuts or changed cut code, base mesh, sweep proof and final bytes.

    The normal Hidamari importer is the sole writer of HD_Harbor. Reimporting the world MUST
    select this same validated opening; a later transport import MUST NOT patch the package.
    """
    build, repo = Path(build), Path(repo)
    target = build / 'hidamari/ferry/HD_Harbor.fbx'
    cut = json.loads((target.parent / 'cut.json').read_text())
    site_path = build / 'ferry/terminals/site.json'
    site = json.loads(site_path.read_text())
    if (cut.get('failures') != [] or not cut.get('cuts') or
            not all(c.get('cap_normals_pass') is True for c in cut['cuts']) or site.get('pass') is not True):
        raise ValueError('Hidamari ferry access cut or sweep failed')
    if cut.get('source') != 'hidamari/assets/HD_Harbor.fbx' or cut.get('site') != 'ferry/terminals/site.json':
        raise ValueError('Hidamari ferry access proof names a different source')
    paths = (repo / 'games/yorimichi/world/regions/hidamari/ferry_cut.py',
             build / cut['source'], site_path)
    expected = {str(p.relative_to(repo)) if p.is_relative_to(repo) else p.name: sha(p) for p in paths}
    if cut.get('inputs') != expected or not target.is_file() or sha(target) != cut.get('output_sha256'):
        raise ValueError('Hidamari ferry access cut inputs or final mesh changed')
    _verify(repo, site['inputs']['code'])
    probes = site['inputs'].get('world_probes')
    if not probes or set(probes) != {'hidamari', 'brinecove', 'crossing'}:
        raise ValueError('Hidamari ferry sweep is missing world probe identities')
    _verify(build / 'ferry/terminals', {f'world_{name}.npz': value for name, value in probes.items()})
    for records in site['inputs']['exports'].values():
        _verify(build, records)
    return target
